name: sound-scape-rampon-koel
title: Rampon koel
description: A rising three-note "ku-oo" call in a bout of three that speeds up, then quiet, then another bout, the way a real koel calls. Only in playful, only with the switch on, and only while a bird is actually visible on screen, read from the same birdX() the scene draws its birds from. attachRamponKoel(sceneEl) wires it to a live <sg-scene name="rampon">.
